= TCK compatibility check

CI runs the unchanged official TCK at revision
`cdfada9c2768b164eadf4bc12e9f9c68e6caf68a`, using its selected Node version,
25.8.2. All 13 cases must pass. A failed or skipped case, harness error or changed
checkout fails the job. There is no known-failure allowance.

The CLI adapter uses Draft mode and projects a smaller graph for this early TCK:

* Omit resolved automatic caption labels, ordinals and no-prefix state. Keep
  titles and explicit document caption settings. Custom caption content still
  needs a supported mapping; it is not silently discarded.
* Omit generated heading IDs unless an exported reference uses the ID. Keep
  explicit IDs, including authored IDs that look like generated ones. Keep
  reference targets and labels intact.

These rules belong to the TCK adapter. It prepares a private tree copy for
caption projection and uses the checked upstream exporter; other unsupported
semantics still fail. Native AST data, parser options, regular ASG exports and
converters are unchanged. The official tests, expected output and pinned schema
are unchanged too.

This projection matches the current test corpus; it does not claim that the
draft generally excludes generated IDs or caption behavior. Review the rules
when updating the pin. Passing these 13 cases does not establish full language
conformance or replace native fixture and converter regression tests.

Run from the repository root after installing the pinned TCK dependencies:

[source,console]
----
cargo build -p acdc-cli --no-default-features --features tck
node --test .github/tck/check.test.mjs
node .github/tck/check.mjs ../asciidoc-tck target/debug/acdc
----

The gate verifies the checkout revision and clean state before and after running
the official harness. Its self-tests reject failures, missing cases and errors.
